compatibility.policy: strict append-only identity: every v1.12 register address, access rule, capability bit, status bit, counter index, counter meaning, execution-mode rule and geometry value is retained; v1.13 changes reachable non-GEMM implementation only

execution_mode_contract.register_access: RW; every 32-bit value can be written and read back, but legality is checked atomically at START
execution_mode_contract.reset_value_policy: mode 0 is deliberately not executable; software must write exact mode 3 or mode 5 before START

mode_3_job_snapshot.model_contract: package-v3 persistent GEMM-B packed as two FP16 values per u32

mode_5_job_snapshot.model_contract: package-v2 blocked-K16/N2 persistent GEMM-B stored as FP32 and converted for FP16 GEMM compute

execution_mode_contract.rejected_modes: 0, 1, 2, and every 32-bit encoding other than exact 3 or exact 5
execution_mode_contract.rejected_start_side_effect_contract: when idle and outside reset-required recovery, no job snapshot, NPU job, performance epoch or AXI DDR request is accepted
execution_mode_contract.priority_boundary: BUSY and RESET_REQUIRED retain their existing higher-priority START-rejection codes; execution-mode rejection applies to an otherwise clean idle START

m7_overlap.counter_map_policy: indices 0..22 and their low/high offsets are byte-for-byte ABI compatible with v1.10, v1.11 and v1.12
m7_overlap.current_production_contract: M8 preserves the exact FP16-only R8/C2 logical and R8/C1 two-pass physical GEMM hierarchy from v1.12. Modes 3 and 5 remain the only legal clean-idle START values. No M8 non-GEMM optimization changes the counter map or its snapshot semantics.

geometry_bits.31:24: physical FP16 stream count; current value 8

s8_schedule.odd_n_policy: skip column-one pass when output_base+1 is outside N
s8_schedule.k_rewind_policy: restore activation_token_base and weight_output_base before the first request of column one
s8_schedule.result_mask_policy: column-zero entry uses 0b01; column-one entry uses 0b10
s8_schedule.result_identity_policy: both partial entries retain the same absolute logical-tile base, token/output/batch coordinates and command generation
s8_schedule.activation_cache_policy: same-tag output-zero K-zero replay preserves a valid A cache
s8_schedule.counter_policy: valid/tail MAC capacity is 8*16=128 slots per accepted physical chunk; term/result/FIFO counters count physical pass activity
s8_schedule.fp32_mode_policy: mode 0 and mode 1 remain readable register encodings for ABI continuity but never enter a removed FP32 GEMM datapath

m8_non_gemm_acceleration.vector_fast_paths: MODE_ADD bypasses the provably unused multiplier; unmasked MODE_SCALE_MASK bypasses the provably unused adder; architectural FP32 rounding points are preserved
m8_non_gemm_acceleration.vector_gelu_read_ahead: bounded gather read-ahead is permitted only through a complete input gather before any result is published; tail and mask bounds remain fail closed

layernorm_row_affine_buffer.oversize_rule: fall back to the v1.12 external-memory schedule

softmax_row_exp_buffer.oversize_rule: fall back to the v1.12 external-memory schedule

full_design_ram_gate.scope_note: inherited distributed RAM elsewhere in the design is not relabelled as an M8 buffer and is not required to be globally zero
